title: count is built in
notes: `count(route)` without `@` is refused with the built-in spelling (APS 6, zega#86).

knownFailure.reason: zegadb/zega#86: the pinned engine (2b5ebd2) has no walk in a condition and no @count; this case records its outcome until the pin moves.

observed.stderr:
error: expected a comparison after count
  schema:130:16
    Airport(count(route) > 1) { code }
                 ^
  help: use `=`, `!=`, `>`, `<`, `>=`, `<=`, `<>`, `findExact`, `findLike`, `startsExact`, `startsLike`, `endsExact`, or `endsLike`
